verdict.rationale: Galileo documents Experiments that evaluate prompts, models, and application code against chosen metrics on well-defined inputs, with a 'Create Experiment' UI flow. That covers the run-and-score foundation for catching regressions across versions, but nothing in the evidence describes actually comparing runs against each other. Missing for 10: an explicit side-by-side experiment comparison view, per-sample or metric diffs between runs, regression flagging between prompt/model versions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
